google/gemini-2.5-flash.mistake: In expressions 8 and 11, the symbol '⊕' is used. In logic, 'A if and only if B' (A ↔ B) means (A → B) ∧ (B → A). The symbol '⊕' typically represents the exclusive OR (XOR) operator (A XOR B), which is true if A is true and B is false, or A is false and B is true, but not when both are true or both are false. This is the opposite of 'if and only if' which is true when both have the same truth value. Therefore, '⊕' does not correctly represent 'if and only if'.
